# Set-ZbxSetting

## SYNOPSIS

Changes the frontend's global settings.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxSetting [-Request] <ZabbixSettingsUpdateRequest> [-Force] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Set-ZbxSetting cmdlet changes the global settings with settings.update. -Request is a ZabbixSettingsUpdateRequest that carries only the settings to change; a hashtable casts to it, keyed by its property names or the API's field names. Every setting left out keeps its value. The command writes the settings as read back after the update, and -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change the work period

```powershell
Set-ZbxSetting -Request @{ WorkPeriod = '1-5,08:00-18:00' } | Select-Object WorkPeriod
```

Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 18:00; graphs shade the rest of the week as non-working time.

### Example 2: Preview renaming a severity

```powershell
Set-ZbxSetting -Request @{ SeverityName5 = 'Critical' } -WhatIf
```

-WhatIf shows the change and makes none.
